page_text_first_1200: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know PDF Intake BETA Preview! PDF Intake is currently in beta mode. Limited functionality and periodic timeouts may be experienced. You may still submit your Form I-765 during this time. My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-765, Application for Employment Authorization Getting Started Client Information Upload PDF Upload Form I-912 Upload Form I-765 Upload G-28 PDF Evidence Review & Submit PDF Form Upload Upload all pages of the Form I-765 in PDF file format only. Place all pages in the correct order by referring to the page numbers on the form. For forms that have been scanned into PDF format, include all pages when uploading, even pages where you were not required to provide information (for example, Part 6. Additional Information is a page that may be left blank, but you should still upload Part 6. with your completed form). You must: Upload one PDF file of the form; Include all pages of the form in the file, even if you did not provide any information on the page; and Arrange the form in the same order as its page numbers.
